title: How 50 Sea Otters Became A Carbon Lifeline
hook: A near-extinction revealed how sea otters protect coastal carbon.
closing: Saving sea otters also preserves kelp habitat and a natural carbon store.
question: Would you protect sea otters?

segments.say: Only 50 sea otters survived the fur trade. That remnant kept the entire population alive.
The population reached about 3,000 sea otters. Their return restored a crucial predator to coastal kelp.
Sea-otter-protected kelp can store 8.7 million metric tons of CO2 yearly. Recovery now safeguards a carbon sink.
